guards.meaning: Lf52.step calls the dispatch only on the branch where no animation is draining.

THE important guard. When the pending-death flag is set, the submitted action is DISCARDED: the engine auto-undoes twice (:5779, :5780), adds a 20-point penalty (:5783), and returns at :5785 without dispatching anything.

available_actions.note: Declared as [1, 2, 3, 4, 6] plus 7 when the module flag STORES_UNDO is set; it is True at :144, so ACTION7 is offered. ACTION5 has a dispatch branch but is NOT in the declared list - a dead branch, as in bp35. No recording on disk, so no observed cross-check.

ACTION6.effect: Two different verbs behind one action, chosen by WHERE the click lands. A click in the bottom-left 16x16 corner of the display, while a flag is set, calls jhgacfwhoa() at :5819 - the SAME function RESET calls at :5837. That is an in-board reset button. Any other click takes the else at :5827, pushes an undo snapshot and acts on the cell.

branch_conditions.meaning: THE branch - a flag is set AND x < 16 AND y > 48. Only then is the click a reset rather than a cell action.

ACTION6.note: This is the third object-dependent-verb instance in this scope, after cn04's ACTION5 and wa30's ACTION5 - and the most dangerous, because the two verbs are 'edit a cell' and 'throw away the level'. Prime tier-3 material if a recording catches it.

ACTION7.effect: Pops the undo stack. As in bp35, this is one of the two branches that does not push a snapshot first. rjfmjxejeiq.aphzlzlgni at :2423 delegates to fbnblnicrc.aphzlzlgni at :809.
ACTION7.note: Offered only because STORES_UNDO is True at :144.

RESET.effect: Restores the level-start snapshot and zeroes the action counter at :5840. rjfmjxejeiq.jhgacfwhoa at :2428 delegates to fbnblnicrc.jhgacfwhoa at :815. Same function the hidden corner-click reset reaches at :5819.
RESET.note: RESET is engine-level and never appears in available_actions, but lf52 handles it in its own source - one of only two games in this scope that does.

unhandled_actions.note: Every GameAction has a branch. ACTION5's is unreachable through the API.

sibling_builds.reason: lf52-271a04aa is the only lf52 build in either replay manifest and the only lf52 directory under docs/static/games/src/. The question does not arise. See dispatch/README.md.

notes: STORES_UNDO at :144 gates both the availability of ACTION7 and the snapshot pushes at :2368, :2382, :2410 and :2415. If it were False the undo branch would still exist and would do nothing.

The pending-death guard at :5778 means the first action after a fatal move is eaten by an automatic double-undo and a 20-point penalty. A record must not read that row as a failed prediction about the action it names - the action was never dispatched.
No recording on disk. Source-only, no cross-check against play.
